event_row_high.eventDescription: One high-impact ForexFactory economic event — the releases that move rates and currencies — with date, time, displayTimezone, currency, impact rating, title, actual, forecast, previous, revised, unit, source agency, and detail URL. First 2 rows per run are free so you can validate output.

event_row_medium.eventDescription: One medium-impact ForexFactory economic event with the same fields as a high-impact row. Priced at the previous flat rate, so a default run (high and medium) never costs more per medium row than before. First 2 rows per run are free so you can validate output.

event_row_low.eventDescription: One low-impact, holiday, or non-economic ForexFactory row with the same fields. These are excluded by default and priced at a fraction of a high-impact release. First 2 rows per run are free so you can validate output.

event_row.eventDescription: Legacy flat-rate event row, retained so runs started from an older build continue to bill correctly during the changeover. New runs bill under the impact-rated events above. First 2 rows per run are free so you can validate output.
